text: “I am a priest, Monsieur Flambeau,” said Brown, “and I am ready to hear your confession.” The other stood gasping for a few moments, and then staggered back into a chair. The first two courses of the dinner of The Twelve True Fishermen had proceeded with placid success. I do not possess a copy of the menu; and if I did it would not convey anything to anybody. It was written in a sort of super-French employed by cooks, but quite unintelligible to Frenchmen. There was a tradition in the club that the hors d’œuvres should be various and manifold to the point of madness.
